CUEVA — Shopify lead-gen funnel

All copy is verbatim from the Master Funnel Register PDF. Every dashed block is an asset slot awaiting the real file from the brand media folder — each one carries the client's own note for what belongs there.

Three things in the source copy needed a decision:
1. The form list was numbered 1, 2, 2, 3, 3, 4, 5, 6 with 5 blank. Renumbered 1–7, no fields added or removed.
2. Page 6 ends mid-word: "…on your phone or computer inst". Set as "instead."
3. The privacy line's emoji did not survive the PDF export. Drawn as a lock icon.

Colours are a placeholder token set — swap the 12 hexes in the Design System artboard once the brand guidelines are to hand.
